android-feedback|Progress indicators.summary: Plenix progress on Android uses the Material 3 LinearProgressIndicator and CircularProgressIndicator, kept native in behavior (progress semantics for TalkBack, Material’s motion) and styled with the Plenix tokens: an 8 dp pill track in the neutral fill with the fill in the tone’s solid color, no gap and no stop dot, a DM Sans label, and a small primary-colored spinner for short waits. Material’s default is a 4 dp track with a gap and a stop indicator, and a 40 dp circle; Plenix keeps Material’s structure and replaces the look.

enum class Tone { Info, Success, Warning, Danger, Neutral }
/** The Plenix progress bar on Android: the Material 3 LinearProgressIndicator, styled with the Plenix tokens. */
fun PlenixProgressBar(value: Float?, label: String? = null, showValue: Boolean = false, tone: Tone = Tone.Info, small: Boolean = false) {

label?.let { Text(it, Modifier.weight(1f), style = textRole(PlenixPlatform.textLabelSize, PlenixPlatform.textLabelLineHeight, PlenixPlatform.textLabelWeight), color = PlenixColors.contentDefault.current()) }
if (showValue && value != null) Text("${(value * 100).roundToInt()} %", color = PlenixColors.contentMuted.current(),
style = TextStyle(fontFamily = Mono, fontSize = PlenixPlatform.textDataSize, lineHeight = PlenixPlatform.textDataLineHeight))   // Mono: PlenixFonts.MONO
val bar = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(if (small) PlenixComponent.progressBarSmTrackHeight else PlenixComponent.progressBarTrackHeight)
val shown by animateFloatAsState(value, tween(durationMillis = PlenixComponent.progressBarFillDuration), label = "progress")
LinearProgressIndicator(progress = { shown }, modifier = bar, color = toneFill(tone), trackColor = PlenixColors.fillNeutral.current(),
